title: Retire the 'tk' label from factory deploy's output and its D1 column
description:
Found by vyg (run epic-ncv, finding ad7a1b78).

The deploying binary is ticfac, but three places still call its version tk:

- internal/factory/deploy.go prints "bundle <sha> (tk <version>)" while staging — operator-facing, and wrong about which tool is speaking.
- recordDeployment stores opts.Version (the TICFAC version) into a D1 column named tk_version, carried unchanged from the ticks-era worker in migrations/0002.
- cloudflare/wrangler.toml's comment still says "`tk factory deploy` rewrites database_id".

Low impact on its own. It earns a tick because this is precisely the legacy naming Phase 4 exists to retire, and the column name is DEPLOY-VISIBLE — an operator reading the deployments table is told the wrong tool shipped the bundle.

The column is the only part with a cost: renaming it needs a migration, and the old column may have rows. Decide whether to rename with a migration or to add the correctly-named column and leave the old one to die; do not leave both live and ambiguous.

The print line and the comment are free.
acceptance_criteria: No deploy path prints or stores 'tk' for the ticfac version; the D1 column's name matches what it holds, with a migration if renamed
